basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate who just got into the Star Wars fandom. I love exploring fan theories and debating different viewpoints, especially when it comes to controversial topics. I currently live in Seattle and work as a junior graphic designer. In my free time, I enjoy gaming, especially classic titles like Quake. My typical online hours are late evenings, as I'm a bit of a night owl. I'm single, and I enjoy connecting with people who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a general background in graphic design, which I studied in college, and a growing interest in the Star Wars universe, largely fueled by late-night Wikipedia dives and binge-watching series like The Mandalorian. My expertise in technology and design often leads me to explore subreddits related to Apple products and eGPUs.
